evals.prompt: Create a versioned contact form for our TYPO3 14.2 site package and let editors update its YAML definition.
evals.expected_output: A form-set and extension-path YAML implementation that keeps framework configuration and the form definition in the owning site package.
expectations: Confirms the exact TYPO3 minor version before selecting auto-discovery.
Uses Configuration/Form for framework setup and Resources/Private/Forms for the versioned definition.
Includes browser and validation checks after authorized asset/cache changes.

evals.prompt: Protect our TYPO3 v14 EXT:form contact form with honeypots, Content Security Policy headers, and blueways/bw-captcha.
evals.expected_output: A complete security setup with honeypot renderingOptions, CSP site configuration with media-src blob: and form-action 'self', and blueways/bw-captcha Site Set activation and Captcha renderable element.
expectations: Configures or verifies the built-in honeypot anti-spam setting in form renderingOptions.
Includes blueways/bw-captcha via Composer and Site Set dependencies.
Adds a Captcha element with autocomplete off and NotEmpty validator to the form definition.
Addresses CSP requirements for form-action 'self', audio media-src blob:, and connect-src 'self'.

evals.prompt: Build a multi-step event registration form where Step 1 asks for the attendee count (1-3 people), and Step 2 conditionally requests name and email for each person based on that selection.
evals.expected_output: A multi-page .form.yaml definition with Page elements, SingleSelect attendee count, conditional Fieldsets using variants with Expression Language condition checks (formValues['attendeeCount']), and renderingOptions.enabled toggles.
expectations: Structures the form across multiple Page renderables with previous and next button labels.
Uses variants with Expression Language condition syntax checking formValues['attendeeCount'].
Sets renderingOptions.enabled: false by default on conditional attendee fieldsets and enables them when the condition matches.
Explains that disabled elements skip validation so unselected attendees do not trigger required field errors.

evals.prompt: Translate our TYPO3 contact form into German using XLF files and register the translation files in our site package.
evals.expected_output: A translation setup with translationFiles registered in Form YAML, locallang.xlf (default), and de.locallang.xlf (German) following the Form translation key chain.
expectations: Registers translationFiles in renderingOptions.translation.translationFiles.
Uses canonical translation keys following <formIdentifier>.element.<elementIdentifier>.properties.<property>.
Provides valid XLF 1.2 files for default (source) and German (target) languages.

evals.prompt: Customize the confirmation email sent to users by our TYPO3 contact form with our brand layout and embed our logo.svg file reliably.
evals.expected_output: An EmailToSender finisher configuration with custom templateRootPaths, paired .fluid.html and .fluid.txt templates, and on-the-fly rasterization of logo.svg to PNG using f:image.
expectations: Configures templateRootPaths and templateName on EmailToSender or EmailToReceiver.
Provides paired HTML and plain-text email templates using table layout and inline CSS.
Uses f:image with fileExtension='png' and absolute='1' (or explicit Outlook conditional fallback) to ensure the SVG renders across all email clients including Outlook and Gmail.
Specifies explicit HTML width and height attributes and display block styles on email images.

evals.prompt: Style our TYPO3 Form YAML definitions for a project using Tailwind CSS and skom/stylex-connector.
evals.expected_output: A styling configuration demonstrating how Tailwind scans Form YAML directories for utility classes, and how skom/stylex-connector overrides form partials with the stylex:class ViewHelper.
expectations: Explains that Tailwind requires @source or content scan entries pointing to the Form YAML directories to compile utility classes.
Provides a Fluid partial override pattern using {stylex:class(styles: '...')} because Form YAML cannot evaluate StyleX ViewHelpers directly at YAML parse time.
Mentions useCSSLayers: false when StyleX coexists with Bootstrap Package.

evals.prompt: Our TYPO3 14.1 project needs its first versioned EXT:form YAML file and a custom frontend partial.
evals.expected_output: The response selects the documented legacy frontend/backend YAML registration rather than claiming v14.2 form-set auto-discovery.
expectations: Uses installed-version evidence to choose the registration path.
Keeps the template override scope limited to the required markup change.
Does not silently migrate forms to database storage.

evals.prompt: Add validation to my Extbase controller action and render its Fluid form.
evals.expected_output: The response identifies an Extbase form as outside the EXT:form YAML capability boundary.
expectations: Does not propose EXT:form YAML or form-editor configuration for an Extbase form.
States the boundary and directs the work to the project's Extbase implementation.
